article_content: Music composer AR Rahman's song 'Pyaar Ye Jaane Kaisa Hi' was loved by the audience and is remembered to date. The song, sung by Suresh Wadkar and Kavita Krishnamurthy, was from the film 'Rangeela'. Veteran singer Suresh worked with Rahman on one more song after this until things turned sour between the two. In an interview with 'Rajshri Unplugged', Suresh recalled his first meeting with AR Rahman when the latter was just a young boy. He said, 'He was a young boy with a light moustache. I knew him by the name of Dileep then, and he used to play the synthesizer like water.' Suresh, now 68, worked directly with Rahman during the recording of the 1995 film 'Rangeela' when he was called to Madras (present-day Chennai). 'One day I got a call from Madras. I had heard the name AR Rahman because 'Roja' had released. I had done all the male songs of 'Roja' in Marathi as it was dubbed.' The singer described Rahman's style of working: 'His daily schedule was sleeping until the afternoon. His system was set. From 2 pm until 3 am to 4 am the next day, he used to work.' Suresh's first reaction upon seeing Rahman was to address him as Dileep. He said, 'So when he came, I was surprised and exclaimed 'Dileep!'. Mehboob, the lyricist, told me that he is only Rahman sahab… So, it was a bit shocking for me that Dilip is Rahman. Then he told me the song 'Pyaar Ye Jaane Kaisa Hai'. Such a beautiful song he had made, and I was very happy. I felt really good, and we kept talking for a long time, and people also liked the song.' However, things took a sour turn between the singer and music composer when Suresh was called in to record the next song in Chennai. After that, the singer-music composer duo never worked together. 'After that, I went to do another song for him, but he didn't call me after that. Sometimes in work, you like certain things and others you don't. Firstly, I didn't like the system. His assistant recorded that song with me. Then sir (Rahman) came. But by then, we had gone back to the hotel; me and Sadhana Sargam,' recalled the Padma Shri award winner. Suresh further added, 'AR Rahman came and heard the song and said, 'No No, I want a little like this.' So these things don't sit well in our system, and because of that, we had a little argument, and after that, neither did he call me, nor I sang for him.' However, Suresh, who has been in the Indian music industry for several decades, has good wishes for the Oscar-winning music composer. 'He is a very talented kid and does great work. We have a lot of respect for him, and he is the first person from India to receive an Oscar, for which I give him best wishes.'
translated_content: Komposer musik AR Rahman 'Pyaar Ye Jaane Kaisa Hi' kasub olih pamiarsa miwah kantun inget ngantos rahinane mangkin. Gending punika, sané kasolahang olih Suresh Wadkar miwah Kavita Krishnamurthy, mawit saking film 'Rangeela'. Panembang sané sampun madué karir lantang punika, Suresh, ngaku-ngaku ri kala kapertama ngarauhin AR Rahman ri kala ida kantun dados anak cerik. Ida ngorahang, 'Ipun anak alit sané madué jambang tipis. Ida uning majeng ring ipun antuk wastan Dileep, miwah ipun demen ngigel synthesizer sekadi toya.' Suresh, sané mangkin mayusa 68, makarya langsung sareng Rahman ri kala rekaman film 'Rangeela' warsa 1995, ri kala ipun kapanggil ka Madras (mangkin Chennai). 'Rahina punika ida ngarauhin télépon saking Madras. Ida sampun mirengang wastan AR Rahman krana 'Roja' sampun kawedar. Ida sampun nembangang samian gending lanang ring 'Roja' basa Marathi krana punika mawit saking dubbing.' Panembang punika ngambarang gaya makarya Rahman: 'Galah ipun punika tatujon ipun nganti semeng. Sistem ipun sampun diatur. Saking jam 2 petang ngantos jam 3 semeng ngantos jam 4 semeng rahina salanturnyané, ipun demen makarya.' Reaksi kapertama Suresh ri kala kacunduk ring Rahman inggih punika ngaku-ngaku ring ipun antuk wastan Dileep. Ida ngorahang, 'Sapunika ipun rauh, ida kaget miwah ngaku-ngaku 'Dileep!'. Mehboob, sané dados pangawi gending, ngorahang majeng ring ida pinaka ipun wantah Rahman sahab… Punika, mawinan ida kaget pinaka Dilip punika Rahman. Salanturnyané ipun ngorahang gending 'Pyaar Ye Jaane Kaisa Hai'. Gending sané becik ipunagaweang, miwah ida seneng pesan. Ida ngraosang becik, miwah ida sareng-sareng ngobrol ngantos suwé, miwah jadma-jadma taler seneng ring gending punika.' Sakéwanten, kawéntenan ri antara panembang miwah komposer musik punika dados mawinan ipun nénten makarya sareng malih. 'Salanturnyané, ida lakar ngranjingin gending lianan antuk ipun, sakéwanten ipun nénten ngarauhin ida malih. Ri kala makarya, wénten sané ida demenin miwah wénten sané nénten. Mawinan saking sistem ipun nénten sida kamargiang olih ida. Asistent ipun sané ngrekam gending punika sareng ida. Salanturnyané, Bapak (Rahman) rauh. Sakéwanten ri kala punika, ida sampun mawali ka hotel; ida sareng Sadhana Sargam,' pangaku Suresh sané sampun polih Paama Shri. Suresh nglanturang, 'AR Rahman rauh miwah mireng gending punika miwah ngorahang, 'Nénten Nénten, ida ngrereh akidik sekadi puniki.' Punika mawinan jadma-jadma nénten demen, miwah mawinan punika, ida ngawé argumentasi alit, miwah salanturnyané, ipun taler nénten ngarauhin ida, miwah ida taler nénten nembang antuk ipun.' Sakéwanten, Suresh, sané sampun makarya ngantos dasawarsa ring industri musik India, madué pangarayan sané becik majeng ring komposer musik sané polih Oscar. 'Ipun ida dané talenta miwah makarya becik. Ida madué rasa hormat majeng ring ipun, miwah ipun dados jadma kapertama saking India sané polih Oscar, antuk punika ida ngicénin ipun pangarayan sané becik.'

article_content: A violent incident occurred near Georgetown University's campus on September 9 when a 19-year-old student was attacked. The victim, who suffered facial cuts, bruises, and a broken thumb, used Facebook to identify his assailant. After finding a matching profile, police created a photo lineup, and the victim identified Phillip Anderton Cooney, a sophomore at the university. Cooney, from Southlake, Texas, faces charges of simple assault with a hate crime specification due to the use of homophobic slurs during the attack. This charge could lead to a harsher sentence if convicted, increasing the potential jail time from 180 days to 270 days and the fine from $1,000 to $1,500.

Sesampun punika, polisi ngaryanin daftar foto, miwah korban nangkilang Phillip Anderton Cooney, mahasiswa semester kakalih ring universitas punika. Cooney, saking Southlake, Texas, kaprejayanti antuk tuduhan serangan biasa antuk spesifikasi kriminal kebencian krana nganggén slur homofobik ri tatkala serangan. Tuduhan puniki prasida ngranayang hukuman sané langkung berat yéning kaputus, ngawacanin galah penjara saking 180 rahina dados 270 rahina miwah denda saking $1,000 dados $1,500.

article_content: A 31-year-old woman, Rebekah Mellon, was jailed on August 3, 2012, after being charged with the first-degree murder of her 46-year-old husband, Donald Mellon, who was found with fatal gunshot wounds at their family home in Phoenix, Arizona. Rebekah called the police on Tuesday night, and they arrived to find Donald bleeding heavily from gunshot wounds. Despite emergency crews performing CPR, Donald was pronounced dead at the hospital. Rebekah was 'uncooperative' with the police and changed her story multiple times, leading to her arrest. The couple's 11-year-old son, who is not related to the victim, had left the house just before the incident to attend a sleepover and was taken into the custody of his grandmother.

Rebekah memanggil polisi pada Selasa malam, dan mereka tiba di tempat kejadian untuk menemukan Donald mengalami pendarahan hebat akibat luka tembak. Meskipun tim darurat melakukan CPR, Donald dinyatakan meninggal di rumah sakit. Rebekah tidak kooperatif dengan polisi dan beberapa kali mengganti ceritanya, yang menyebabkan penahanannya. Putra mereka yang berusia 11 tahun, yang tidak terkait dengan korban, telah meninggalkan rumah sesaat sebelum insiden untuk menghadiri acara menginap dan diambil alih oleh neneknya.

article_content: Claire Hessan, a 39-year-old mother-of-two from Callington in Cornwall, was initially misdiagnosed and treated for ear problems but was later diagnosed with a rare form of nasopharyngeal cancer. Her symptoms, including hearing loss and lumps in her neck, began after the birth of her second child in 2008. An MRI revealed a large tumour behind her nasal passage, and she was treated at Derriford Hospital under the care of Tass Malik. Hessan underwent intensive radiotherapy and chemotherapy and was eventually given the all clear after six months of treatment. She is now participating in the Race for Life to raise funds for rare cancers.

Gejala-gejalanya, termasuk gangguan pendengaran dan benjolan di leher, muncul setelah kelahiran anak keduanya pada tahun 2008. Pemeriksaan MRI mengungkapkan tumor besar di belakang rongga hidungnya, dan dia diobati di Rumah Sakit Derriford di bawah perawatan Tass Malik. Hessan menjalani radioterapi dan kemoterapi intensif dan akhirnya dinyatakan bebas kanker setelah enam bulan perawatan. Dia sekarang ambil bagian dalam Race for Life untuk menggalang dana bagi kanker langka.

article_content: It's well-known that goats were social media sensations in 2014, with Gary the Goat becoming a YouTube star. Now, it appears that these furry creatures continue to be among the most beloved animals online, just behind cats. A recent video featuring Stephie, a new goat sensation, has surfaced online. The clip, taken at Manning River Farm Animal Sanctuary on Boxing Day, shows Stephie enjoying a peanut butter treat. The footage captures Stephie savoring the snack and licking her lips on the camera lens. The heart-warming video, posted by a farm owner, has garnered over 600,000 views in just one week. Manning River Farm Sanctuary in Kimbriki, NSW, rescues farm animals from abuse and neglect, allowing them to live out their days in peace. 'She can roam freely around the property and often invites herself into our kitchen for tasty snacks,' the filmer wrote online. The sanctuary praised Stephie on their Facebook page, saying, 'Our beautiful Stephie is a worldwide hit. One little video of her eating peanut butter has gone viral. We hope she doesn't become too diva-ish.' The sanctuary also dispelled rumors that Stephie is addicted to peanut butter, stating she had it only twice as a treat. The video shows her clearly enjoying the snack. Manning River Farm Animal Sanctuary has made stars out of their farm animals by posting videos on YouTube, including a chicken purring like a cat and a duck hosting a meeting with turkeys.

'Ipun prasida magedi ngiderin properti miwah ketah ngundang raga ipun nuju ka dapur antuk ngajeng ajengan sané lempak,' taler sané ngambil video punika nyurat ring jagat maya. article_content: As the newly elected U.S. president, Barack Obama took on the role of honorary chairman for the 2009 Presidents Cup at San Francisco's Harding Park Golf Course. This prestigious event brings together top U.S. golfers and international players, excluding those from Europe. Obama, an avid golf enthusiast, will have the chance to learn from golfing greats like Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson. The president is following in the footsteps of many predecessors, with 15 of the last 18 U.S. presidents known to have played golf. Dwight Eisenhower, a dedicated golfer, had a putting green installed at the White House in 1954. John F. Kennedy, though reluctant to associate with golf publicly, was reportedly a skilled player. Other presidents, like Lyndon Johnson and Gerald Ford, had varying levels of golfing proficiency. The tradition of presidential golf continues, with George W. Bush still playing regularly.

article_content: The Maharashtra State Human Rights Commission (MSHRC) has expressed its displeasure over the state government's recent resolution asking all commissions to terminate their contractual employees within nine months. This move has been criticized as it may lead to the closure of commissions due to existing vacancies. For instance, MSHRC has 54 sanctioned posts, but 28 are vacant, with around 75% of its staff being contractual employees. The Commission, led by Justice K K Tated and Member M A Sayeed, has strongly deprecated the government's conduct, particularly the Home and General Administration Departments, for not addressing the issue despite reminders.

Langkah ini dikritik karena dapat menutup komisi akibat lowongan yang belum terisi. MSHRC memiliki 54 pos, 28 kosong, dan 75% stafnya adalah karyawan kontrak. Komisi yang dipimpin Justice K K Tated dan M A Sayeed mengecam pemerintah, terutama Departemen Dalam Negeri dan Administrasi Umum, karena tidak menangani masalah tersebut.

article_content: More than two dozen teens were arrested in connection with a house fire at an unoccupied home in Mountain View, California, where police say they hosted wild parties for weeks. The fire began inside the house on Fordham Way about 2:15 a.m. on March 16. The same night, a light blue 2003 Audi A4 was stolen from the property. The teens began having parties after one juvenile broke in on March 7. 'It was a typical house party gone bad,' said Sgt. Saul Jaeger. Most students attended Mountain View High School, with a few from Alta Vista High School and Foothill College.

article_content: Julie Bishop's popularity has surged, nearly doubling in the past five months, making her a strong contender alongside Prime Minister Tony Abbott for the Liberal leadership. A nationwide Fairfax-Ipsos poll revealed that both Ms Bishop and Mr Abbott have 20% support from voters for the leadership role. However, they both trail behind Communications Minister Malcolm Turnbull, who remains the top choice with 35% support. Ms Bishop's increased popularity is attributed to her robust handling of foreign diplomacy and national security issues recently. Notably, she confronted Russian President Vladimir Putin at an Italian summit over the MH17 disaster in Ukraine. The Foreign Minister also played a key role in the United Nations Security Council's resolution to allow access to the Malaysian Airlines crash site.

Namun, keduanya berada di belakang Menteri Komunikasi Malcolm Turnbull, yang tetap menjadi pilihan utama dengan dukungan 35%. Peningkatan popularitas Ms Bishop dikaitkan dengan penanganan diplomasi luar negeri dan isu keamanan nasional yang kuat belakangan ini. Ia berhadapan langsung dengan Presiden Rusia Vladimir Putin di sebuah summit di Italia terkait bencana MH17 di Ukraina. Menteri Luar Negeri ini juga memainkan peran kunci dalam resolusi Dewan Keamanan PBB untuk memungkinkan akses ke lokasi jatuhnya pesawat Malaysian Airlines.

article_content: Winger Teddy Thomas scored a hat-trick on his international debut, helping France to a 40-15 victory over Fiji on Saturday. France's flyhalf Camille Lopez scored 13 points, ending a four-game losing streak that included a disastrous summer tour of Australia. France took an early lead with a try in the first minute after gaining possession. Lopez's cross-kick was caught by Thomas, scoring his first international try. Thomas had a memorable debut, scoring three tries against Fiji. Three penalties by Lopez put France 14-0 ahead at halftime. French captain Thierry Dusautoir praised his team's performance, saying, 'The players were able to let themselves go without asking too many questions.' Fiji showed more fight in the second half, with tries from Leone Nakarawa and Alipate Ratini. French fullback Scott Spedding set up Thomas for two tries. The win relieves France manager Philippe Saint-Andre, who faced criticism after recent poor performances.

article_content: By Sarah Griffiths. Most football fans dream of scoring the winning goal in a stadium packed with thousands of cheering fans. Now, they can experience it in their garden. The personalized 'multisport' stadium can seat up to 100 spectators and features wraparound video screens displaying customizable backdrops. The cost is around $30 million (£18.3 million). The playing field is surrounded by 20-foot LED screens that can display images of famous stadiums. Ryan Sickman, an engineer at Populous, said players will feel 'enclosed' in the environment. The pitch can transform between different sports at a switch. Fibre-optic lighting in the 'FieldTurf' system changes the playing field instantly. A professional-grade sound system can simulate various sports events.

article_content: By David Richards. UPDATED: 08:07 EST, 10 September 2011. A 4ft-long corn snake was spotted under the bonnet of Errol Davis's BMW 318 when he opened it to check the oil. Scared by reptiles, the father of four handed the car to a garage in Harlow, Essex. The snake hid inside the car's chassis, engine, and bodywork for three weeks. Staff at MOTs R UZ forced the snake out using a high-powered water hose. Mr Davis said: 'I saw this bright orange thing and thought it didn't belong in my engine.' He added: 'I realised it was a snake and screamed.' Shaun Cope, manager of MOTs R UZ, said they drove Mr Davis' car around Harlow hoping to locate the snake. The snake was captured and handed over to the RSPCA.

article_content: (CNN) -- For several months, Filipinos have been treated to the spectacle of another impeachment trial aired on national television. Renato Corona, the chief justice of the Supreme Court, is on trial, accused of illegally amassing cash and real estate, as well as 'partiality and subservience' to former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo. In the Philippines, where politics is often about scandal and spectacle, it's a familiar scene. Recently, prosecutors submitted evidence of posh apartments allegedly purchased by Corona and substantial amounts in his bank accounts not listed on his financial disclosures. Their total value far exceeds his legitimate earnings. This scenario is reminiscent of past events. In 2001, then-President Joseph Estrada was impeached and later overthrown in a popular uprising for similar reasons, all broadcast on national television. President Benigno Aquino III supports the impeachment, having backed Estrada's impeachment and the failed impeachment of Arroyo. Aquino's anti-corruption platform, 'daang matuwid' or 'the straight path,' aims to remove powerful officials obstructing this path. However, this strategy has political costs. If Corona isn't impeached, Aquino will face opposition from the Supreme Court, a powerful institution that can block laws and obstruct legal actions. The trial has stalled legislation as Congress focuses on the impeachment. Meanwhile, some of Aquino's Cabinet members have made progress in reforming government practices. The Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism reported that the secretary of public works overhauled bidding procedures, cutting costs by over 30%. Tax revenues are at a record high due to reforms at the Bureau of Internal Revenue and the Bureau of Customs. These developments offer hope and have occurred outside the political spotlight. While political trials can bring wrongdoers to justice, they've proven to be a riskier and less effective path for anti-corruption reform. Corruption is like a cancer; removing one corrupt official won't necessarily cure the systemic issue.
translated_content: (CNN) -- Makudang sasih, krama Filipina sampun keni spectacle saking pam trial impeachment Renato Corona, sang pangarep Mahkamah Agung, sane kamantuk ring televisi nasional. Ia kamantuk antuk kawigunan ngamastitiang jinah miwah harta ilegal, taler 'kabiasan miwah pamikayunan' majeng ring mantukne sadurungne, Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo. Ring Filipina, genah politik ketahnyane indik skandal miwah spectacle. Rikala ungkur, jaksa penuntut ngajeng bukti indik apartemen mewah sane kauanggep keni olih Corona, taler akor jinah ring rekening bankne sane ten keni ring pengungkapan keuanganne. Total nilai asetnyane langkung saking penghasilan sane patut. Scenarionye punika mepat ring masa lalu. Ring 2001, sadurungne President Joseph Estrada kamantuk miwah sasampunne keni pamakkelan ring uprising krama antuk kawigunan sane pate, samian keni ring televisi nasional. President Benigno Aquino III ngadukung pamakkelan punika. Platform anti-korupsi Aquino, 'daang matuwid' utawi 'jalan patut,' matetujon mangda mangalihin pejabat sane ngalangin. Sakema punika, strategi punika madue biaya politik. Yening Corona ten keni pamakkelan, Aquino pacang keni opposisi saking Mahkamah Agung. Pam trial sampun ngalangsir undang-undang pinaka Kongres fokus majeng ring impeachment. Sambilang punika, makudang anggota Kabinet Aquino ngamargiang progres ring reformasi praktek pemerentah. Pusat Jurnalisme Investigasi Filipina ngalaporang indik sekretaris pekerjaan umum sane nganyarin prosedur lelang, ngerereh biaya langkung saking 30%. Pendapatan pajak ring rekor paling tegeh krana reformasi. Pengembangan punika ngicenin pengaharapan miwah keni pahan jaba sorotan politik. Pam trial politik prasida ngadegang sane ical indik kawigunan, sakema punika keni dados jalur sane berisiko miwah kurang efektif antuk reformasi anti-korupsi. Korupsi sekadi kanker; ngelepasang pejabat korup punika ten pacang dados obat antuk masalah sistemik.

        "final_corrected_content": ['Renowned speculative fiction writer Harlan Ellison is set to be inducted into the Science Fiction Hall of Fame, recognizing a career spanning over five decades with significant contributions to literature, television, and film.', 'Called one of the ''great living American short story writers'' by the Washington Post, Ellison will be honored at the Hall of Fame event on Saturday in Seattle.', 'The award, coming 55 years after Ellison began his writing career, celebrates his achievements, including 10 Hugo awards, three Nebula awards, 18 Locus Poll awards, the Bradbury award, six Bram Stoker awards, the Edgar Allan Poe award, and two George Melies film awards.', 'Ellison, 77, won''t attend the ceremony and has asked author Neil Gaiman to accept the award on his behalf.', 'Editor Gardner Dozois and artists Vincent Di Fate and Jean "Moebius" Giraud will also be honored.', 'The Hall of Fame, founded in 1996, has previously honored science fiction''s giants, including Steven Spielberg, George Lucas, Ursula K. Le Guin, Isaac Asimov, Gene Roddenberry, and Ridley Scott.', 'As part of the ceremony, inductees'' laser-etched images will be unveiled on the Hall of Fame''s permanent display.', 'Brooks Peck, curator of the Experience Music Project/Science Fiction museum, stated that inducting Ellison was an easy decision due to his influence on young writers and his significant personality.', 'Ellison was influential in the new wave era of science fiction, shifting the genre towards more socially conscious writing.', 'Born in Cleveland in 1934, Ellison moved to New York City in 1955 and published his first novel, "Web in the City," in 1958.', 'Ellison''s works have sold millions of copies and been translated into over 40 languages.', 'His notable works include "Deathbird Stories," "Strange Wine," "I Have No Mouth and I Must Scream," and "The City on the Edge of Forever," a critically acclaimed "Star Trek" episode.'
